narrative.intro: Fluor Intercontinental obligated $279M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 13 awards, with an average award size of $21.5M. Fluor Intercontinental recorded obligations up 89.2% year over year for the fiscal year to date. Fluor Intercontinental has a multi-year history of federal obligations, with fiscal-year totals of $286M in FY21, $313M in FY22, $34.6M in FY23, $142M in FY24, and $148M in FY25, showing FY26 obligations at $279M. Fluor Intercontinental concentrates FY2026 to date obligations in Facilities Support Services at $279M, while Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) shows $500 and All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services shows $0. Fluor Intercontinental’s current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the listed award-count and averages reflect obligations, not total contract values for awards or expiring contracts.

sections.heading: What is Fluor Intercontinental’s FY2026 to date performance?
sections.body: Fluor Intercontinental obligated $279M in FY2026 to date through 13 awards. Fluor Intercontinental’s average award size is $21.5M, and obligations are up 89.2% year over year. Fluor Intercontinental’s FY26 total is larger than FY23, FY24, and FY25 totals, and close to FY21 and FY22 levels.
